comment: I love Dr. Barney!!! He is a great professor who teaches well with a fun sense of humor and high energy. 10/10 would recommend!

Having Professor Barney for my freshman fall really set a good tone for me. He is extremely nice to us and creates a super engaging environment by being super funny and helpful. It is a lot of reading, but it all pays off when the exams have review sheets and internet access. I am confident he will be my favorite professor after 4 years here!

Barney is one of my all time favorite teachers. He is so passionate about what he teaches and can monologue the entire class if he wanted. As a map nerd myself, his FYS stands as my favorite UR course. Dr. Barney is easy to meet with for office hours consultations. He teaches you how to write at a college level and gives helpful feedback on essays.

Professor Barney is definitely the best professor I have had. He always comes to class with a great attitude and wants the best for all of us. I wish I could have him as a professor every semester because he truly made me want to come to class. Take his FYS!!!

I LOVE Dr. Barney. Probably the best professor I have had since being at Richmond. Such a kind caring guy. He expects a lot, but also gives a lot. Very fair grader, and is very open to extensions on papers. Will give in-depth feedback on your work and will happily meet with you.

Caring prof who teaches each class like the last. Not the most interesting topic whatsoever but Dr. Barney made me almost excited to come to class each day. Readings for homework every night but he does'nt check if you do them, there is'nt much class material based on them. Only prof I'll make a review for. If you are a freshmen, take this class.

Dr. Barney is the goat. Nicest teacher I have ever had. Is a very lenient grader, very understanding, and keeps the class engaged during lectures. There is a lot of reading and writing, as well as a couple presentations, but it is definitely worth it.

Barney is the best! Genuinely just a good human being: caring, understanding, and accessible. The class is very reading heavy and there is a substantial amount of work, but he is a very easy grader. Class is mostly discussion-based, which is fun if you actually do the readings. Overall a lot of work but not difficult at all.

Dr. Barney is enthusiastic, funny, and caring. He gives incredibly thorough feedback, writing multiple paragraphs of comments on your papers. He assigns 20-40 page readings for each class, but you don't need to do them. There are a lot of projects so it can be a little overwhelming, but Barney is very lenient on deadlines. Best prof at UR.
One of the nicest humans you'll ever meet. Love this guy and he genuinely cares about each one of his students. Knows what he teaches and makes it interesting.

Barney is super passionate and just a great guy all around. There are a ton of readings, but you can easily just skim them for a couple key points and provide a couple comments in the class discussions and you'll be fine; you don't need to actually do all that much reading. The class is overall both super easy and super fun, so perfect for an FYS.

Dr. Barney is incredibly passionate about maps and his students, yet there are some areas that this course falls short. There are way too many readings, but I did none of them and still got A's on the reading quizzes. Additionally, there was a data entry project I could only compare to unpaid labor. The rest of the class is a breeze and is fun!

Dr. Barney is my favorite professor at UR. He's witty, engaging, and inspiration. I was a map nerd coming into college, but taking the Rhetorical Lives of Maps with him took my fascination to the next level. The material is interesting and unique, and Dr. Barney really cares about his students. Take advantage of ANY opportunity to take his class.
Seriously cares about the students and extremely passionate about maps. Wish I could take him again.
Simply the best.

Dr. barney is a personable, funny, and overall a great guy. The type of professor that wants to see you do well and learn the material. Very passionate about his discussions and curriculum. Brings a positive attitude every class and will appreciate you more if you do the same. Highly recommend

Fantastic in every way. He gives clear, extensive feedback on every assignment, is engaging with every student, and easily found outside of class. The curriculum all ties together and helps immensely with writing, public speaking, and critical thinking. Be prepared to go "nerd deep," but he keeps it chill. He cares about the class and it shows.

A truly inspirational professor with a clear passion for rhetoric. A must for any major, and for anyone with even a passing interesting in the department or the Cold War. There's a lot of reading and the extensive papers will take work for an A, but the end result is rewarding and Barney will help you every step of the way.

Dr. Barney is one of the best professors I've had at Richmond. He's hilarious, engaging, and smart. In addition, he gives amazing feedback; whenever you write a paper, he will attach a full page with the strengths and weaknesses of your paper AND write comments in the margins. He does assign a lot of reading but does a good job of explaining it

Dr. Barney is one of the nicest professors in the RHCS department. He is so funny and an incredible teacher, but gives SO much work. He expects a lot out of his students and treats us like he is the only class we have (he will assign 75 pages of reading per class). A lot of work, but he's a really cool guy and makes a boring topic fun

Even though there was a lot of reading and group projects, I ended up really enjoying this class. Dr. Barney is hilarious and can always find a way to make you laugh, even at 9:00am. I'm not really interested in maps or rhetoric but taking this class allowed me to branch out from my normal science classes. I would recommend this class to anyone.

Full of energy and is very passionate about what he teaches. He assigns a decent amount of work but I never felt overwhelmed since it's nicely spaced out and gives helpful comments on rough drafts. His prompts are extremely detailed so you'll always know what he's looking for and he'll actually make you laugh on a regular basis
Really helpful and nice! Best prof!

Barney brings in a lot of energy to class. If you take him for FYS, you'll get a couple papers, a presentation, and a few 2 page blog posts. He loves his students and makes corny pirate jokes. His readings are way too long though, although they are quite interesting.
best professor ever. It's a privilege to take a class with Barney. Awesome, nice, brilliant, hilarious guy. put in the work, you'll get a good grade and learn a lot.

Mr. Barney is a great professor overall, especially for a 9am.  He's energetic, funny & engaging.  The readings can be a bit lengthy & boring but class is focused and interesting.  He is passionate about what he teaches & it's clear that he wants his students to learn.  Definitely take Barney for any class!  I hope I can have him for many more!!!!!
